one_line: Enterprise CRM and platform-as-a-service with an extremely broad set of APIs for managing accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and custom objects.
auth_notes: OAuth2 web-server and JWT bearer flows require a Connected App (client id/secret) registered in the org; SOAP API uses session id / username-password (legacy). Free Developer Edition org provides an integration-testing sandbox. Requests hit instance or login.salesforce.com with a session token.
self_serve_notes: Free Developer Edition org is self-serve; register a Connected App there to get OAuth credentials. No payment required.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Thousands of endpoints across REST/SOAP/Bulk/Streaming/Metadata/Tooling/GraphQL APIs covering the entire platform
api_surface.webhook_note: Push Topics, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Apex callouts for real-time notifications

existing_mcp.note: Official Salesforce MCP server exists (Agentforce/AI era); multiple community servers on GitHub/MCP registry

evidence.note: Fetched text was a thin trail/marketing page (~1.2KB, JS shell); facts from knowledge of the platform plus official docs URL

agent_notes: Fetched page is marketing, not API docs; auth and MCP claims based on well-known platform knowledge. Very broad but requires Connected App setup.
